raw as (
  select (bn_cy::numeric/nullif(cap_cy,0))::float8 cy, (bn_ly::numeric/nullif(cap_ly,0))::float8 ly, (bn_cfy::numeric/nullif(cap_cfy,0))::float8 cfy, (bn_lfy::numeric/nullif(cap_lfy,0))::float8 lfy from nx, capx
), v as (
  select cy, ly, cfy, lfy, 0.95*cfy as tgt from raw
)
select '% Ocupación' as lbl, cy, ly, tgt, cfy as fy,
  replace(round(abs((cy-ly)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as yoytxt,
  case when (cy-ly) < 0 then '▼' else '▲' end as arrow,
  case when (cy-ly) < 0 then '#A0453D' else '#56B14E' end as yoycolor,
  (case when (cy-tgt)>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round(abs((cy-tgt)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as pcttgt,
  case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end as tgtcolor,
  case case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#2F7A34' when '#E0A800' then '#B7860B' else '#A0453D' end as tgttext,
  case case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#E9F5EA' when '#E0A800' then '#FCF3DA' else '#FBECEA' end as tgtbg,
  least(100,greatest(0, cy/nullif(tgt,0)*100))::int as barw,
  least(100,greatest(0, cfy/nullif(lfy,0)*100))::int as fybarw,
  (case when (cfy-lfy)>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round(abs((cfy-lfy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as fypct
from v

  mpp as (select s.pid, s.pn, s.m, coalesce(nam.prodacc,0) prodacc, coalesce(nam.bn,0) bn,
            coalesce(nam.res,0) res, cam.cap, coalesce(xam.prodex,0) prodex, coalesce(pam.pax,0) pax
          from spine s join cam on cam.pid=s.pid and cam.m=s.m
            left join nam on nam.pid=s.pid and nam.m=s.m
            left join xam on xam.pid=s.pid and xam.m=s.m
            left join pam on pam.pid=s.pid and pam.m=s.m),
  grpm as (select 'Grupo'::text pn, m, sum(prodacc) prodacc, sum(bn) bn, sum(res) res,
            sum(cap) cap, sum(prodex) prodex, sum(pax) pax from mpp group by m),
  allm as (select pn,m,prodacc,bn,res,cap,prodex,pax from mpp
           union all select pn,m,prodacc,bn,res,cap,prodex,pax from grpm),
  pvm as (select pn, m,
            (bn)::numeric/nullif(cap,0) occ, bn, prodacc/nullif(bn,0) adb,
            prodacc/nullif(cap,0) revpab, prodacc+prodex prod, prodacc, prodex, res,
            (bn)::numeric/nullif(res,0) los, pax from allm),
  vl as (select pn, m, 'occ' metric, (occ)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'bn' metric, (bn)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'adb' metric, (adb)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'revpab' metric, (revpab)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'prodtot' metric, (prod)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'prodacc' metric, (prodacc)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'prodex' metric, (prodex)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'resci' metric, (res)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'los' metric, (los)::float8 cy from pvm union all select pn, m, 'pax' metric, (pax)::float8 cy from pvm),
  met as (select * from (values ('occ','% Ocupación','pct','avg','Operación',1,1,1),('bn','Bednights','int','sum','Operación',1,2,1),('adb','ADB','eur','avg','Operación',1,3,1),('revpab','RevPAB','eur','avg','Operación',1,4,0),('prodtot','Producción Total','keur','sum','Producción',2,5,1),('prodacc','Producción Aloj.','keur','sum','Producción',2,6,1),('prodex','Producción Extras','keur','sum','Producción',2,7,1),('resci','Reservas','int','sum','Comercial',3,8,0),('los','LOS (noches/res)','dec','avg','Comercial',3,9,0),('pax','Huéspedes','int','sum','Comercial',3,10,0)) t(metric,label,fmt,agg,sec,secord,mo,tgt)),
  grid as (select vl.metric, me.label, me.fmt, me.agg, me.sec, me.secord, me.mo, vl.pn,
      case when vl.pn='Grupo' then 0 else 1 end as prard,
      max(case when m=1 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m1,
      max(case when m=2 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m2,
      max(case when m=3 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m3,
      max(case when m=4 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m4,
      max(case when m=5 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m5,
      max(case when m=6 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m6,
      max(case when m=7 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m7,
      max(case when m=8 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m8,
      max(case when m=9 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m9,
      max(case when m=10 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m10,
      max(case when m=11 then (case when cy is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round(((cy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round(((cy)/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round((cy)::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round((cy)::numeric)::bigint::text end end) end) as m11,
      (case when (case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end) is null then '' else case fmt when 'pct' then replace(round((((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' when 'keur' then replace(round((((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))/1000)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' K€' when 'eur' then replace(round(((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||' €' when 'int' then round(((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))::numeric)::bigint::text when 'dec' then replace(round(((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))::numeric,2)::text,'.',',') else round(((case agg when 'sum' then sum(cy) else avg(cy) end))::numeric)::bigint::text end end) as total
    from vl join met me on me.metric=vl.metric
    group by vl.metric, me.label, me.fmt, me.agg, me.sec, me.secord, me.mo, vl.pn)
select metric, 'ytd' as kind, sec as section,
    case when prard=0 then 'first' else 'sub' end as rowcls,
    case when prard=0 then label else pn end as lbl,
    13 as cs,
    m1,m2,m3,m4,m5,m6,m7,m8,m9,m10,m11, total
from grid order by secord, mo, prard, pn
